verdicts.reason: A: headline and subtitle share a clean left edge, but there is about 140px of dead space at the left and a large empty gap before the Shop Now button, which is stranded at the far right. The NEW badge has shrunk to an illegible speck under the subtitle, cut off from the product and jammed against the bottom edge, and the LUMEN & FIG label on the jar is unreadable. B: the group is tighter and the CTA sits closer to the copy, but 'Night Cream' is centred while the subtitle is set off to the left, so their edges almost line up but don't. The NEW badge is the same tiny, detached speck crammed at the bottom edge, and the whole cluster floats in the middle with empty sides, so it reads as shrunk rather than laid out as a banner.
